### Launch guided interactive setup for a specific channel

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/cli/channels.md

Opens the guided setup wizard directly for the specified channel without first presenting the full channel picker. Passing no credential flags triggers interactive prompts.

```bash
openclaw channels add telegram
openclaw channels add --channel telegram
```

--------------------------------

### Run channels add guided setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/signal.md

Launches the interactive setup wizard to detect or install signal-cli and configure the bot phone number and daemon endpoint.

```bash
openclaw channels add
```

--------------------------------

### Run OpenClaw installer with onboarding

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/installer.md

Installs OpenClaw and immediately launches the onboarding setup flow upon completion.

```bash
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://openclaw.ai/install-cli.sh | bash -s -- --onboard
```

--------------------------------

### Install and set up the Honcho plugin

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/concepts/memory-honcho.md

Installs the Honcho plugin, runs interactive setup to configure credentials or migrate memory files, and restarts the gateway.

```bash
openclaw plugins install @honcho-ai/openclaw-honcho
openclaw honcho setup
openclaw gateway --force
```

--------------------------------

### Configure turn start parameters

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/test/fixtures/agents/prompt-snapshots/codex-runtime-happy-path/telegram-direct-codex-message-tool.md

Specifies execution parameters for starting a turn, including sender details, source delivery policies, and temporal context.

```json
{
  "additionalContext": {
    "openclaw_current_sender": {
      "kind": "untrusted",
      "value": "{\"sender\":{\"id\":\"1000001\",\"name\":\"Pash\",\"username\":\"pash\"}}"
    },
    "openclaw_source_delivery": {
      "kind": "application",
      "value": "Current source-delivery policy for this turn (replaces earlier source-delivery guidance):\nVisible source replies are not automatically delivered for this run. Use `message(action=send)` for user-visible source-channel output. For progress, set `final=false`. Set `final=true`, or omit it, for the completed reply to the current source conversation; OpenClaw stops after confirming delivery. Do not repeat visible message content in your final answer.\n\n`send`: `message`; current source is default target. Set `target` only elsewhere."
    },
    "openclaw_temporal_context": {
      "kind": "application",
      "value": "## Temporal Context\nCurrent date: 2026-01-01\nTime zone: UTC\nFor the exact current time, use `session_status`."
    }
  },
  "approvalPolicy": "never",
  "approvalsReviewer": "user",
  "collaborationMode": {
    "mode": "default",
    "settings": {
      "developer_instructions": null,
      "model": "gpt-5.5",
      "reasoning_effort": "medium"
    }
  },
  "cwd": "/tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace",
  "effort": "medium",
  "input": [
    {
      "text": "<see Reconstructed Model-Bound Prompt Layers>",
      "text_elements": [],
      "type": "text"
    }
  ],
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "personality": "none",
  "sandboxPolicy": {
    "type": "dangerFullAccess"
  },
  "threadId": "thread-telegram-direct-codex-message-tool",
  "turnTrigger": "user"
}
```

### Set OpenClaw Thread Start Parameters

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/test/fixtures/agents/prompt-snapshots/codex-runtime-happy-path/telegram-direct-codex-message-tool.md

Configures thread execution settings such as approval policies, feature flags, dynamic tool registrations, workspace directory, model selection, and sandbox security level.

```json
{
  "approvalPolicy": "never",
  "approvalsReviewer": "user",
  "config": {
    "features.apply_patch_streaming_events": true,
    "features.code_mode": {
      "direct_only_tool_namespaces": ["openclaw_direct"],
      "enabled": true
    },
    "features.code_mode_only": false,
    "features.goals": false,
    "features.shell_tool": true,
    "features.standalone_web_search": false,
    "project_doc_max_bytes": 131072,
    "suppress_unstable_features_warning": true,
    "tools.update_plan.enabled": false,
    "web_search": "cached"
  },
  "cwd": "/tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace",
  "developerInstructions": "<see Reconstructed Model-Bound Prompt Layers>",
  "dynamicTools": [
    "agents_list",
    "message",
    "sessions_spawn",
    "automations",
    "gateway",
    "nodes",
    "session_status",
    "sessions_history",
    "sessions_list",
    "sessions_search",
    "sessions_send",
    "subagents",
    "tts",
    "web_fetch",
    "web_search",
    "sessions_yield"
  ],
  "experimentalRawEvents": true,
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "personality": "none",
  "sandbox": "danger-full-access",
  "serviceName": "OpenClaw",
  "threadSource": "openclaw"
}
```

--------------------------------

### Run guided onboarding setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/clickclack.md

Launches the interactive onboarding wizard to configure the ClickClack server URL, bot token, and workspace. Failed validation checks do not discard saved configuration.

```bash
openclaw onboard
```

--------------------------------

### Install OpenClaw using the official install script

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/help/faq-first-run/quick-start.md

Downloads and runs the OpenClaw installer script. The installer automatically starts guided onboarding.

```bash
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
```

--------------------------------

### Start development Gateway with hot reload

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/start/setup.md

Installs dependencies, performs initial setup if needed, and starts the Gateway in a tmux watch session with hot reload.

```bash
pnpm install
# First run only (or after resetting local OpenClaw config/workspace)
pnpm openclaw setup
pnpm gateway:watch
```

--------------------------------

### Quick start build and run commands

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/apps/swabble/README.md

Installs Swift tools, builds the project, creates default configuration, runs the daemon, tests hooks, and performs audio transcription.

```bash
# Install the repository-pinned Swift tools
../../scripts/install-swift-tools.sh .build/swift-tools
export PATH="$PWD/.build/swift-tools:$PATH"

# Build
swift build

# Write default config (~/.config/swabble/config.json)
swift run swabble setup

# Run foreground daemon
swift run swabble serve

# Test your hook
swift run swabble test-hook "hello world"

# Transcribe a file to SRT
swift run swabble transcribe /path/to/audio.m4a --format srt --output out.srt
```

--------------------------------

### Install Fastlane via Homebrew

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/apps/android/fastlane/SETUP.md

Installs Fastlane for standard local setups.

```bash
brew install fastlane
```

--------------------------------

### Launch onboarding setup in Podman container

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/podman.md

Starts the onboarding setup process inside the container. Complete authentication at http://127.0.0.1:18789/ using the gateway token stored in ~/.openclaw/.env.

```bash
./scripts/run-openclaw-podman.sh launch setup
```

--------------------------------

### Install and start OpenClaw Gateway on ChromeOS

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/platforms/chromeos.md

Quick installation path to run the installer script, onboard and install the systemd daemon, and verify Gateway service status.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
```

```bash
openclaw onboard --install-daemon
```

```bash
openclaw gateway status
```

--------------------------------

### Run interactive Matrix channel setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/matrix/setup.md

Starts the interactive setup wizard to configure the homeserver URL, authentication, optional device name, E2EE, and room access.

```bash
openclaw channels add
openclaw configure --section channels
```

--------------------------------

### Install Google Meet plugin and run node host

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/google-meet/transports.md

Install the Google Meet plugin in the VM and start the node host pointing to the Gateway host.

```bash
openclaw plugins install @openclaw/google-meet
openclaw node run --host <gateway-host> --port 18789 --display-name parallels-macos
```

--------------------------------

### Recover broken npm installation using the installer

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/updating/update-methods.md

Re-runs the installer targeting the npm install method to recover a partially updated npm package when triage cannot start.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash -s -- --install-method npm
```

--------------------------------

### Run interactive onboarding

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/apple-fm.md

Starts the interactive setup process and initiates local background discovery for eligible Apple Foundation Models. The option is presented once probe checks confirm availability and at least 8,192 context tokens.

```bash
openclaw onboard
```

--------------------------------

### Install OpenClaw without onboarding on Windows PowerShell

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/index.md

Executes the PowerShell installation script with the `-NoOnboard` flag to install OpenClaw without starting onboarding.

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((iwr -useb https://openclaw.ai/install.ps1))) -NoOnboard
```

--------------------------------

### Install OpenClaw on macOS, Linux, or WSL2

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/index.md

Runs the OpenClaw automated installation script in bash. The script detects the operating system, installs Node if needed, installs OpenClaw, and starts onboarding.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
```

--------------------------------

### Start QA Lab with fast UI iteration

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/concepts/qa-e2e-automation/operator-flow.md

Builds the Docker image and QA Lab web bundle, runs the prebuilt image with `extensions/qa-lab/web/dist` bind-mounted into the container, and watches for changes.

```bash
pnpm openclaw qa docker-build-image
pnpm qa:lab:build
pnpm qa:lab:up:fast
pnpm qa:lab:watch
```

--------------------------------

### Install and start node on node host

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/google-meet/troubleshooting.md

Installs the Google Meet plugin, enables browser support, and runs the node host pointing to the Gateway.

```bash
openclaw plugins install @openclaw/google-meet
openclaw plugins enable browser
OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_PRIVATE_WS=1 \
  openclaw node run --host <gateway-lan-ip> --port 18789 --display-name parallels-macos
```
